class.name: SfxGeneratorPlayback
class.description: Assign a subclass to [member SfxClip.generator_playback] of a clip whose stream is an [AudioStreamGenerator]. One resource may serve many voices at once: keep per-voice state in what [method _create_state] returns. [method _update] runs on a worker thread.

method.name: _cleanup
method.description: Called once when the voice stops.

method.name: _create_state
method.description: Called once when a voice starts; returns its state, handed back to [method _update] and [method _cleanup].

method.name: _update
method.description: Called every tick while the voice plays: push frames into [code]context.stream_playback[/code]. [param context] also holds [code]delta[/code], [code]playback_position[/code], [code]event_name[/code], [code]clip[/code], [code]event_time[/code], [code]parameters[/code], [code]automation_name[/code] and [code]automation_value[/code].
